integrity: Exact combinatorial enumeration and a standalone arithmetic checker corroborate the proof; no external independent assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact-field classification is for F3 only. Geometric smoothness follows from an algebraic derivative argument; finite experiments alone do not establish it. Prior literature may contain unlocated equivalent results, and a relevant blocking-set classification full text was not accessible.
title: A unique nontrivial blocking cubic over the ternary projective plane
